title: Caper-Butter Cod Foil Packets
seoTitle: Caper-Butter Cod Foil Packets | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Cod packet night—lemon caper butter steam on the grill, not baked
subtitle: Foil-packet cod, caper butter, and herb steam for ten
description: Cod fillets seal in foil packets with lemon, capers, cherry tomatoes, and white wine butter, grill until 145°F, and open at the table for aromatic steam.

steps.title: Build foil packets
steps.instruction: Place each cod portion on heavy foil. Top with butter pat, capers, tomatoes, lemon slice, thyme, wine, salt, and pepper. Seal tightly.

steps.title: Heat grill
steps.instruction: Preheat grill to medium, 400°F. Have sheet pan ready for packet transfer.

steps.title: Grill packets
steps.instruction: Grill sealed packets 12–14 minutes until puffed and cod reads 145°F through foil.

steps.title: Check doneness
steps.instruction: Open one test packet—flesh should flake and butter should be bubbling. Re-seal others if holding.

steps.title: Hold sealed
steps.instruction: Hold finished packets sealed at 140°F up to 15 minutes on sheet pans.

steps.title: Open at service
steps.instruction: Open packets at the line for steam and aroma. Watch for hot steam burns.

steps.title: Finish with parsley
steps.instruction: Scatter parsley over opened packets. Spoon caper butter over fish.

steps.title: Platter for ten
steps.instruction: Serve one packet per firefighter with crusty bread for soaking butter.

proTips: Double-fold foil seams—leaky packets lose steam and dry out.
White wine in the packet creates steam; don't skip it.
Open packets away from faces—steam exits fast.
tonightSpread: Grilled cod lemon packets with caper butter.
Grilled asparagus or green salad on the side.
leftovers: Flake cod into fish stew with packet butter.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Foil packets cook evenly and hold in the packet at 140°F for a short window—perfect when the crew might get toned out mid-service.
mealPrepNotes: Build packets ahead. Grill medium 400°F, 12–14 minutes. Hold sealed packets at 140°F up to 15 minutes. Open at service for steam and aroma.
